observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor lawn in front of a covered stage with seated spectators, under daylight
observation.dancers: group of women and teenage girls
observation.formation_and_space: group in loose lines and rows facing the stage, stepping in place and traveling slightly
observation.posture: torso upright or hinged forward from hips with a deep knee bend, knees soft and bouncing
observation.footwork: fast, light alternating steps on the balls of the feet keeping time with the drums; exact foot placements obscured by skirts and grass
observation.arms_and_hands: arms bent at elbows with hands holding small white cloths or handkerchiefs, waving them in circles or pulsing up and down
observation.hips_and_torso: torso tilts forward from the waist during deep knee bounces, emphasizing hip movements
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level maintained through deep knee bending and torso hinges; no jumps or prominent turns visible
observation.costume_and_props: white t-shirts with green accents, colourful patterned wrap skirts or flared skirts, holding small white cloths
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement on the ground is hidden by skirts and grass; subtle weight shifts are uncertain due to video sample rate

signature_moments.what: group of women marching forward onto the lawn holding white handkerchiefs and waving them overhead
dancers in two rows hinge their torsos forward with deep knee bends while holding white handkerchiefs near their hips
